entry.title: By: Carl Abbott
entry.content:
I’m happy to hear the essay worked better for you than the AI ‘podcast’, and I note your misgivings about the AI.  I certainly have mixed feelings about the AI audios. They offer an overview, but on the other hand introduce misleading stuff. Should I throw out the baby with the bath water is the question.

To help answer that, I’ve gathered the best of the AI’s and placed them in AI Deep Dive ‘Podcasts’. Hopefully, I’ll get some helpful feedback to guide me on this matter.

entry.title: By: Theresa
entry.content: I just finished your essay and found it to be excellent. Thank you. I appreciated the gentle nudge away from free will. Final paragraph encouraging understanding and forgiveness is positive. I also just listened to the seven minute AI deep dive and it is 100 times less effective than Your written essay. I tried to listen to the audio at half speed. It was too slow and the Normal speed, speedy. Overall, i did not like the dialogue.I suppose one of these AI audios would spark interest from a seeking person and your invitation to read the full essay attached could result in a deeper dive. Myself, i listened again and found it underwhelming.
